description: This tool enables the search of packagist packages that support laravel with advanced filters. When presenting results, ALWAYS include the laraplugins_url alongside the plugin name so the user can consult the full health report.

is_secure.description: Filter by LaraPlugins Secure badge. true to only show secure plugins.

laravel_compatibility.description: Search by plugin's laravel compatibility where there is at least one version supporting that laravel version (eg 10).

php_version.description: Search by plugin php compatibility where there is at least one version supporting that php version (eg 8.5).

return_archived.description: Return archived plugins as well in the results?.

text_search.description: Search by text in plugin name or description.

vendor_filter.description: Search by plugin vendor name. (eg: spatie)

name: search-plugin-tool

health_score.description: Health score as a string, e.g. "A", "B", etc.

health_score_reasons.description: List of reasons that explain the health score.

items.description: Reason contributing to the health score.

is_laraplugins_secure.description: Whether the plugin has the LaraPlugins Secure badge.

laraplugins_url.description: URL to the human-readable plugin detail page on laraplugins.io. MUST include this when presenting the result.

title: Search Plugin Tool
